excerpt: The psychedelic ceremony was associated with increases in Fatalistic determinism at 4 weeks versus baseline (t(121) = 2.81, p = 0.012, d = 0.25, 95% CI [0.06, 0.37]); however, this effect did not persist at 6 months. For psychedelic-naive participants, the 6-month effect persisted (t(52) = 2.86, p = 0.012, d = 0.39, 95% CI [0.11, 0.64]).
overview: This result separates fatalism from the more durable non-physicalist belief changes. It shows that psychedelic-associated belief change is not uniform across metaphysical domains and that subgroup history matters: the overall sample shows a temporary fatalism increase, while first-time users show a longer-lasting one.
title: Fatalism Time Course
